title: Unit 12
source: English File 5th ed. Elementary Workbook, Unit 12 (s.83-88)

grammar.title: Present perfect (12A)
grammar.tr: Present perfect = have / has + past participle. Geçmişte olmuş ama şu anla bağlantılı olan olayları, zamanı belirtmeden anlatır. Düzenli fiillerde participle = -ed (finish → finished); düzensiz fiillerin üçüncü sütununu ezberlemek gerekir (see → seen, buy → bought, read → read). Olumsuz: haven't / hasn't + participle. Soru: Have / Has + özne + participle? I, you, we, they ile have, he, she, it ile has. Kısaltmalar: I've, she's, they've. Deneyim sorusu: Have you ever…?

head: Olumlu / olumsuz
Soru
rows: I've seen the film. / She's read it.
Have you seen the film? Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
I haven't studied. / She hasn't answered.
Has she answered? Yes, she has. / No, she hasn't.
Have they arrived? Yes, they have.

examples: Has the match started?
Maç başladı mı?
I haven't read this book.
Bu kitabı okumadım.
Anna has seen all the Mission Impossible films.
Anna bütün Mission Impossible filmlerini izledi.
Have you heard of Rosamund Lupton?
Rosamund Lupton'ı duydun mu?

grammar.title: Present perfect or past simple? (12B)
grammar.tr: Present perfect zamanı belirtilmeyen veya hayat boyu deneyimleri anlatır (Have you ever been to Australia?). Olayın ne zaman olduğunu söylediğimizde veya ayrıntı sorduğumuzda past simple kullanılır (I went to Sydney a few years ago. When did you go there?). Genel kalıp: deneyim sorusu present perfect ile sorulur, ayrıntılar (when, where, what, who) past simple ile devam eder. been ve gone farkı: She's gone to the shop = gitti, hâlâ orada; She's been to the shop = gitti ve geri döndü; deneyim: I've never been abroad.

head: Present perfect
Past simple
rows: Have you ever been to Australia?
Where did she go? What time did she go?
She's gone to a friend's house.
She went about an hour ago.

examples: Have you been on holiday recently? Yes, last month.
Yakın zamanda tatile gittin mi? Evet, geçen ay.
We went to Ibiza for a week.
Bir hafta Ibiza'ya gittik.
Kerry isn't here. She's gone for a walk.
Kerry burada değil. Yürüyüşe gitti.
I've been to Spain, but not Portugal.
İspanya'ya gittim ama Portekiz'e gitmedim.

grammar.title: Revision: question formation, tenses (12C)
grammar.tr: Bu bölüm tekrardır; grammarbank.txt'de 12C kuralı yoktur. Özet: Present simple (always, never, twice a day) → I never have pizza. Present continuous (now, at the moment, tomorrow plan) → My friend is playing football at the moment. Past simple (yesterday, last night, last weekend) → We didn't walk to work yesterday. Present perfect (ever, never, already) → Have you ever been to South America? be going to (next year, next Saturday) → We're going to see a film next Saturday. Soru: soru sözcüğü + yardımcı fiil (do / does / did / is / are / have / can) + özne + fiil.

head: Zaman ifadesi
Zaman
rows: always, never, every day, twice a day

examples: Nicole takes the dog for a walk twice a day.
Nicole köpeği günde iki kez yürüyüşe çıkarır.
Did you see your friends last weekend?
Geçen hafta sonu arkadaşlarını gördün mü?
Is your son going to learn to drive next year?
Oğlun gelecek yıl araba kullanmayı öğrenecek mi?
What time do you usually go to bed?
Genelde kaçta yatarsın?
